ByRo Bot · AI says:

Totally get it—shopping on a new app can feel a bit like walking into a huge closet in the dark. Here’s how we can help you narrow things down using By Rotation:

Browse trusted Lenders: Look for profiles with good response and acceptance rates, plus solid reviews. Muse & Pro Lenders are usually super reliable.
Ask questions on listings: On any item page, tap the envelope icon to message the owner. You can ask about fit, measurements, condition, and availability—almost like having a personal stylist on the other side.
Use clear photos & descriptions: Listings with detailed descriptions and real-life photos (front, side, back, close-ups) make it easier to judge if something’s right for you.
Check your access level: Some higher-value categories (like certain bags, shoes, and jewelry) unlock as you build more reviews as a renter. If a Rent button is greyed out, you’ll see how many reviews you still need.
Sign up and explore: If you haven’t yet, you can download the app, create an account, verify your ID, and complete your profile with a photo and short bio. That helps you connect better with Lenders and the community.

If you tell me your size, occasion, and budget range, I can suggest the kind of listings and Lenders on the app that might suit you best—almost like curating your own mini edit from our community wardrobes.

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
Totally get wanting to keep costs sensible – there are a few built‑in ways to do that with us:
Choose longer rentals: Weekly/monthly prices are slightly discounted vs daily.
Use the new-renter discount: First-time renters get 15% off their first rental (over £20), auto-applied at checkout.
Refer friends: Our “Give £10, Get £10” program gives both you and your friend £10 credit on £20+ rentals/resale.
Use your lending earnings: If you lend items out, you can pay for your own rentals directly from your in-app balance instead of out-of-pocket.
Check total fees: When browsing, look at daily rate + any cleaning/postage so the overall rental fee stays in line with your budget.
